description: This file defines the DonationResponse class, which handles responses related to Stripe checkout sessions within the Omnipay Stripe subscription module. It manages redirect responses and checks the success status of a donation via Stripe sessions.

classes.name: DonationResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a donation request, handling redirect logic and success verification based on Stripe checkout session.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DonationResponse with a request and Stripe checkout session.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if the Stripe checkout session status indicates completion.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Confirms that this response involves a redirect.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect the user to Stripe checkout.
